Bar.AuditHint: Asset audit: every file the world makes players download, and the world's data size.

Editor.TitlePlaceholder: The Mortuary | Sigil, City of Doors
Editor.TitleHint: Use “|” for a smaller second line. Leave empty for no title.

Reveal.Hidden: Name hidden from players. Click to reveal it.
Reveal.Shown: Name shown to players. Click to hide it.

Remove.Title: Remove from Theater
Remove.Body: Remove {name} from this scene? The image file itself stays.

Notice.Legacy: This scene has {count} item(s) made by the old macro. Import them to use them here.

Notify.OnlyGM: Only the GM can use the Theater.
Notify.NoImages: No images found in that folder.
Notify.PlacesLoaded: Every image in that folder is already loaded.
Notify.CastLoaded: Every portrait in that folder is already loaded.
Notify.SoundMissing: The linked sound no longer exists.
Notify.Imported: Imported {count} item(s) from the old macro.
Notify.NothingToImport: Nothing to import on this scene.
Notify.PreloadStart: Preloading {images} image(s) and {sounds} sound(s) on every connected client…
Notify.PreloadFailed: Some files failed to load for: {names}. Check their browser console.
Notify.PreloadMissing: No reply from: {names}. They may still be loading, or may not have this module enabled.
Notify.PreloadNobody: Preloaded here. No players are connected.
Notify.PreloadLocalFailed: {count} file(s) failed to load on your own client.
Notify.ActivatedAll: “{name}” is active and all {count} connected player(s) are viewing it.
Notify.ActivatedSome: “{name}” is active, but only {here} of {total} players are viewing it yet. Not there: {names}.
Notify.ActivatedNobody: “{name}” is active. No players are connected.
Notify.BlackFailed: Could not set the scene background to black. Set the background colour in Scene Configuration.
Notify.OptimizeStart: Checking {count} image(s) for a lighter copy…
Notify.NothingToOptimize: Every image on this scene is already light.
Notify.OptimizeFailed: {count} image(s) could not be optimized; they keep their original file. See the console (F12).
Notify.NothingToRestore: No optimized images on this scene.
Notify.Restored: Restored the original images on {count} tile(s).

TitleHold.Name: Title card duration (seconds)
TitleHold.Hint: How long a place's title card stays on screen before it fades out.

SoundFade.Name: Default sound fade (seconds)
SoundFade.Hint: Fade applied to a linked sound the first time it is used, if the sound has no fade of its own.

Fade.Name: Fade by default
Fade.Hint: Starting state of the Fade checkbox in the Theater panel.

ClearCast.Name: Clear cast when changing place
ClearCast.Hint: Starting state of the “Clear cast on new place” checkbox in the Theater panel.

OptimizeOnAdd.Name: Optimize images when adding
OptimizeOnAdd.Hint: When you add places, heavy images (PNG, or over 1 MB) get a lighter WebP copy first. The originals are not changed.

DuckSoundboard.Name: Turn the Soundboard down over the map
DuckSoundboard.Hint: While a place is shown over the map to everyone, Planar Soundboard narrates (music and ambience dip), so the place's own sound comes through. Needs Planar Soundboard.

LowerOnCombat.Name: Take the picture down when combat starts
LowerOnCombat.Hint: When combat begins or initiative is rolled, whatever is shown over the map is taken down so everyone sees the map.

SlowMap.Name: Slow the map behind a full-screen place
SlowMap.Hint: While a place covers the whole screen, the map behind is drawn at a few frames a second. Saves the graphics card on laptops.

Keybinding.Peek: Over the map: hold to see the map
Keybinding.PeekHint: While a picture is shown over the map, hold this key to see the map through it.
Keybinding.Lower: Over the map: take the picture down (GM)

Optimize.Title: Optimize images
Optimize.Body: Heavy images on this scene (PNG, or over 1 MB) get a lighter WebP copy, up to 2560 px wide, and the Theater uses the copy. Players download a fraction of the size; on screen it looks the same.
Optimize.Note: The original files stay where they are. “Restore originals” puts them back on this scene.

Audit.Title: Asset audit
Audit.FilesHint: Every image, sound and video the world's documents and settings use, biggest first. Heavy files slow down joins and scene changes for every player. Hover the count to see where a file is used.
Audit.OptimizeHint: Make a lighter WebP copy and use it everywhere this image is used. The original stays.
Audit.RepointHint: Replace this file with another one everywhere it is used.
Audit.NoGain: The WebP copy would not be much smaller, so the image was left as it is.
Audit.CantOptimize: This image can't be optimized here (it is on another server).
Audit.RepointBody: Replace “{from}” with “{to}” in all {count} place(s) that use it?
Audit.WorldSummary: World data: about {total}. Every player downloads all of it when they join.
Audit.WorldHint: Imports (Plutonium, compendium drags) pile up here. Actors and items nobody uses at the table can move to a compendium: they stay one drag away but are no longer sent to every player. Anything on a scene, owned by a player, in a combat or linked from a journal, a macro or a module stays.
Audit.MoveBody: Move {count} document(s) ({size}) into the “Planar Archive” compendium and delete them from the world? You can import them back from the compendium at any time.
Audit.Moved: Moved {count} document(s) to the Planar Archive compendium.

Keep.OnScene: Has a token on a scene
Keep.Linked: Linked from a journal, macro or module

Audit.OptimizeAllHint: Give every heavy image a lighter WebP copy and use it everywhere: every scene, actor, journal and setting. The originals stay.
Audit.OptimizeAllStart: Optimizing {count} image(s). This can take a minute…
Audit.LiteAudioHint: For every heavy sound that has a “<name>.lite.ogg” next to it on the server (made by the lighten-audio script), use the light copy everywhere.
Audit.LiteAudioDone: Switched {count} sound(s) to their .lite.ogg copy in {docs} document(s). {missing} heavy sound(s) have no copy yet. Sounds already playing switch the next time they start.

Over.Title: Theater — over the map ({scene})
Over.PreloadHint: Every connected player's browser downloads this Theater scene's pictures and sounds now, so they appear at once over the map.
Over.ImageHint: Show any image from the server over the map, with an optional title card.
Over.ImageTitle: Show a picture over the map
Over.Hint: You're on a map. Click a place to show it over the map, click an NPC to bring them in or out; players stay on this scene and come back to it when you take it down. Drag a place or NPC onto the map to pin it there: only you see the pin; double-click it during play. A second click on the place that is up re-sends it with the choices above.
Over.NoTheater: There is no Theater scene in this world yet. Press “New scene”, add places and cast there, then come back to this map.
Over.NoPlaces: This Theater scene has no places.
Over.NoCast: This Theater scene has no NPCs.
Over.NotFound: Theater: nothing called “{name}” on any Theater scene.
Over.LoweredForCombat: Combat started: the picture over the map was taken down.
Over.StrayTiles: {count} Theater picture(s) are drawn on this map's own canvas, under its fog and lighting, and players may see them there. Hide them; from now on places go over the map.

OnAir.Title: Over the map:
OnAir.Preview: See it as the players do (your own screen only)
OnAir.HideHint: Take it down: everyone is back on the map.

Overlay.PeekMouse: Hold here to see the map

Enricher.OffHint: Theater: take the picture over the map down.
Enricher.PlaceHint: Theater: show this place over the map.
Enricher.CastHint: Theater: bring this NPC in over the map, or send them out.

RemoveAll.Hint: Remove all of these from this scene (asks first). The image files stay on the server.
RemoveAll.PlacesBody: Remove all {count} place(s) and their title cards from “{scene}”? The image files stay on the server, so you can add them again.
RemoveAll.CastBody: Remove all {count} NPC card(s) from “{scene}”? The portrait files stay on the server, so you can add them again.

Pins.DragHint: click to show over the map; drag onto the map to pin it there
Pins.Created: Pinned “{name}” to the map. Double-click the pin to show it over the map.
Pins.CreatedDoor: Pinned “{name}” next to a door: when the door opens you'll be asked whether to show it. Double-click the pin to show it any time.
Pins.NotesShown: Map notes are now shown, so you can see your Theater pins (players never see them).
Pins.Failed: Theater: the pin could not be created. See the console (F12).
Pins.DoorLinked: Linked to the nearest door. Move the pin next to another door to link that one.
Pins.NoDoor: No door within 2½ squares. Move the pin next to a door to link it.
